## Types of changes

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior or config)
- [ ] Documentation / tooling only

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check` and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] README / docs updated if user-facing behavior or MCP tool signatures changed
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, or private data in code, tests, or fixtures
- [ ] I have disclosed any AI assistance and can explain the change in my own words
